“What can Oasis do?” FAQ

Built-in reply when users ask about capabilities in natural language (tabs, organization, history/bookmarks context, page help—aligned with in-product overview text).

What this is

If you ask what Oasis or the assistant can do in natural language, Oasis can answer with a concise FAQ-style summary (tabs, organization, page help, general Q&A).

How to use it

  • Try: “What can you help me with in this browser?”
  • Compare with the capabilities overview insert for a longer, structured list.
  • Use feedback if an expected capability is missing.

Notes and limits

The FAQ heuristic looks for questions about capabilities; very short or ambiguous prompts may not trigger it.
